pairs.name: The Antennae
pairs.what: Two spirals a few hundred million years after their first close pass. Two long, curved tidal tails arc away like an insect's antennae, while the colliding centres blaze with new star clusters.

pairs.name: The Mice
pairs.what: Two galaxies just past their first close approach, each trailing one long, straight tail — the shape Toomre & Toomre matched with a prograde, nearly parabolic encounter.

links.label: ESA/Hubble: The Mice (Advanced Camera for Surveys)

pairs.name: The Cartwheel
pairs.what: A small galaxy punched almost straight through a big disk. The sudden extra gravity pulled the disk inward, then it rebounded: an expanding ring wave, like a stone dropped in a pond.

pairs.name: Arp 273
pairs.what: A rose-shaped spiral distorted by a smaller companion that probably passed through it. Try the Cartwheel-like preset with the pericentre raised to a few kiloparsecs and the tilt increased.

links.label: ESA/Hubble: A rose made of galaxies
